title: WSUG: Tidy up formatting of filter string documentation.
description:
Improve consistency of use of monospace for text which we're presenting as part
of a filter string, and of use of parentheses "()" to more clearly distinguish
between functions and operators.

And fix the "test"-vs-"text" typo which got me started on this bit of
tidying-up.

It was a bit of a nightmare to get the formatting of the "A-B"/"A -B"/"A - B"
examples correct on both the HTML and PDF presentations.  I followed the
explanation and suggested solution in the AsciiDoctor documentation:
https://docs.asciidoctor.org/asciidoc/latest/text/troubleshoot-unconstrained-formatting/#unconstrained-edge-cases

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
